integrity: Finite exact rational certificates and a standalone Python standard-library verifier are included. Historical priority is qualified, and no external scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact results only for binary rotation-class codes of length one through nine under one deletion. Not a claim about ordinary rooted codes, other channels, longer lengths, full equality classifications or experimental DNA implementation.
title: First fractional-shadow packing gap for binary necklace deletion codes
